title: Absorbed source provenance
description: provenance.json, written by a completing absorption run. The registry in references/upstream/ is the human view of this; the run is what knows the digests, so a human transcribing them is a copy that can disagree with the run that produced it.

source.description: Source identifier as it appears in the registry.

location.description: Where a reader obtains the source. Absent for a source that was never published.

baseline_kind.description: Which kind of identifier `baseline` holds. Recorded because a commit SHA and a local tree digest are both hex strings and mean entirely different things: one is resolvable upstream, the other only against a snapshot this repository took.

absorbed_on.description: Date the run completed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

plan_sha256.description: Digest of the plan the run was bound to. Sources absorbed in one run share it, which is why the field is per-record rather than per-source.

run_id.description: Groups records written by one run, so a shared plan digest reads as one batched absorption rather than as a transcription error.
